truth_yaml_said.x-notes: Wrapped {balances:[...], count:N}. Pagination IS respected. Same BalanceListResponse shape as time-off/balance/policy/{policyId}. Both specs document this endpoint.

properties.count: integer (authoritative total count across all pages)

probe_1_nonexistent_userid.finding: Non-existent userId returns HTTP 200 with {balances:[], count:0}. No 404. Clockify silently returns empty results rather than raising an entity-not-found error for unknown userId values.

probe_2_valid_user_high_page.finding: Requesting a valid userId on page 999 (well beyond any real data) returns {balances:[], count:0}. count=0 on high page is surprising — may indicate count is not stable across pages, or the real user has no time-off policies configured.

probe_3_page_overflow.error_message: must be less than or equal to 1000
probe_3_page_overflow.finding: Page number is capped at 1000 by Clockify API. TRUTH.yaml documents page parameter with default:1 but NO maximum constraint — this is a gap in the spec.

finding_1.description: Non-existent userId returns HTTP 200 {balances:[], count:0} instead of 404. TRUTH.yaml does not document any error response for this path — it only shows 200. The observed behavior is consistent with the documented 200, but it means callers cannot distinguish 'user not found' from 'user has no time-off balances' via this endpoint.
finding_1.severity: informational — TRUTH.yaml is not wrong, but silent-200 for missing entity is worth noting

finding_2.description: Page parameter has a server-enforced maximum of 1000 (returns 400 'must be less than or equal to 1000' if exceeded). TRUTH.yaml documents page with default:1 but omits the maximum:1000 constraint.
finding_2.severity: minor spec gap — TRUTH.yaml should add maximum: 1000 to page parameter

notes: Three sub-probes: (1) nonexistent userId → 200 with empty envelope, not 404; (2) valid userId at impossibly high page → 200 with empty envelope; (3) page=99999 → 400 with 'must be less than or equal to 1000'. Key findings: Clockify returns silent-200 for unknown userId (no 404), and page is server-capped at 1000 (undocumented in TRUTH.yaml). Neither finding demotes the LIVE-VERIFIED status — the 200 shape and pagination behavior are still correct — but two spec gaps were identified.
